about: v3: questions authored blind from page renders only, on pages whose routed item is a cropped raster

candidates.q: In panel A of the knockin schematic, what fragment length is printed on the bracket spanning the two BamHI (B) sites of the unmodified locus, line (1)?
candidates.why_arbitrary: the measured restriction-fragment length of this particular locus could have been any value

candidates.q: Under the left histogram of panel D (Eomes), which MFI value is printed for the wt sample?
candidates.why_arbitrary: a measured fluorescence intensity printed on the panel, not derivable by convention

candidates.q: On the colour bar serving the top row of heatmaps, which intermediate tick labels are printed between 0.0 and 1.0?
candidates.why_arbitrary: an unevenly spaced set of tick labels chosen by the plotter

candidates.q: In the third (right-hand) column of heatmap panels, which quantity is plotted on the horizontal axis?
candidates.why_arbitrary: which of the three vote fractions was assigned to that column's x axis could have been otherwise

candidates.q: In the WPT / two-way communication block diagram, what text is printed above the double-headed arrow that links the external side to the implanted side?
candidates.why_arbitrary: the specific standard number printed on the link arrow

candidates.q: Which two memory blocks are drawn inside the inner dashed box on the implanted side of the block diagram?
candidates.why_arbitrary: the particular memory blocks drawn in that box are a design choice shown only in the diagram

candidates.q: In the Small-Signal Overshoot vs Load Capacitance graph, what is the topmost label on the vertical Overshoot (%) axis?
candidates.why_arbitrary: the axis was scaled to an arbitrary maximum for this plot

candidates.q: In the Settling Time vs Closed-Loop Gain graph, the two plotted curves are annotated with which pair of percentages?
candidates.why_arbitrary: the two settling accuracies the manufacturer chose to plot

candidates.q: In the Line Regulation graph, which three temperatures appear as coloured swatches in the in-plot legend?
candidates.why_arbitrary: the specific temperature set measured for this sweep could have been otherwise

candidates.q: In the Inrush Current scope capture, what per-division scale is printed at the right-hand end of the I_IN trace?
candidates.why_arbitrary: the oscilloscope vertical scale chosen for that one trace

candidates.q: In the mode-operation timing diagram, how many blue 'sampling' blocks are drawn on the middle (Normal Mode) time axis?
candidates.why_arbitrary: the number of sampling events the illustrator drew on that trace

candidates.q: What label is printed to the left of the bottom trace in the mode-operation timing diagram?
candidates.why_arbitrary: the wording of the third trace's row label as printed in the figure

candidates.q: In the query-satisfaction plot, what factor is printed above the longest (topmost) horizontal double-headed arrow?
candidates.why_arbitrary: a measured gap ratio annotated on the plot

candidates.q: What is the lowest tick label on the vertical Queries (%) axis of the query-satisfaction plot?
candidates.why_arbitrary: the axis was truncated at an arbitrary lower limit

candidates.q: In the coloured stability-region map, what word is printed as the vertical axis label?
candidates.why_arbitrary: an idiosyncratic axis-label word the authors typed into the plot

candidates.q: In the three-panel time-series row, what is the lowest tick label on the population axis of panel (b)?
candidates.why_arbitrary: only that one panel's axis was extended below zero

candidates.q: Which of these values appears as a tick label on the horizontal time axis of the FEV1/PEFR plot?
candidates.why_arbitrary: an irregular measurement time printed as a category tick

candidates.q: At the 4-hr tick of the FEV1/PEFR plot, what value does the open-circle PEFR series show?
candidates.why_arbitrary: a plotted measurement at one time point

candidates.q: Which series appears in the legend of the left-hand bar chart but not in the legend of the right-hand bar chart?
candidates.why_arbitrary: which series the authors omitted from the second panel is a presentation choice

candidates.q: In the right-hand bar chart, roughly what value does the OOD bar for the Cov4 group reach?
candidates.why_arbitrary: a measured bar height read off the axis

candidates.q: In the data matrix drawn inside the 'Non-leave Node Data' box of the flowchart, what value is shown in the last row (row n) under column x3?
candidates.why_arbitrary: the toy matrix entries are invented illustration numbers that could have been any values

candidates.q: In the right-hand (dashed-outline) flowchart, which linear combination is shown in the LCIV box fed by the LASSO diamond?
options: η = β1x1 + β2x2 + β3x3 + β4x4 + β5x5
candidates.why_arbitrary: which subset of variables the illustrative LASSO branch happens to retain is an authoring choice, and all four equations appear in the same figure

candidates.q: In the right-hand oscilloscope capture (Start-Up, Zoomed In), what horizontal timebase is shown in the Timebase readout at the bottom of the screen?

candidates.q: What trigger level is displayed in the Trigger readout box of both oscilloscope captures?
candidates.why_arbitrary: the trigger threshold the engineer dialled in is an arbitrary instrument setting printed only in the screenshot

candidates.q: In panel A of the schematic, what number is printed in green with the 'true effect' label on the X→Y edge?
candidates.why_arbitrary: the effect size of the sampled example world is a specific plotted number that could have been otherwise

candidates.q: In panel B of the schematic, what text is written inside the black-outlined box that the top context strip's arrow feeds into?
candidates.why_arbitrary: the checkpoint name and parameter count printed in the box are labels chosen by the authors

candidates.q: In the Power Supply Rejection vs Frequency graph, which bypass-capacitor value labels the leftmost (highest-rejection-at-low-frequency) curve?

candidates.q: In the Total Harmonic Distortion vs Frequency graph, what output power is listed in the test-condition block inside the plot?

candidates.q: In the middle panel of the framework diagram, what tuple is printed on the arrow leaving the globe icon?

candidates.q: What label is written on the orange cylinder drawn at the centre-right of the middle panel?
candidates.why_arbitrary: the exact wording stamped on that component is an authoring choice among several plausible names

candidates.q: In the questionnaire figure, item 3 lists symptoms with a score in parentheses after each. How many points are assigned to 'Need help from someone else'?
candidates.why_arbitrary: the point weight given to each symptom in this modified scoring scheme is an arbitrary design decision

candidates.why_arbitrary: item 8's scale is reverse-scored, so the value attached to 'Never' is a printed choice rather than an inferable one

candidates.q: The cumulative-hazard chart carries a subtitle line under its title. How many participants does that subtitle state?
candidates.why_arbitrary: the analytic sample size printed in the chart subtitle is a specific number that could have been otherwise

candidates.q: On the cumulative-hazard chart, what is the largest labelled tick on the horizontal (Days of trial) axis?
candidates.why_arbitrary: the axis extent chosen for this plot is an arbitrary tick extreme

candidates.q: In the perspective drawing of the metasurface (upper figure), which letter labels the axis arrow that points toward the lower right of the panel?
candidates.why_arbitrary: which coordinate letter the authors assigned to each drawn axis direction is an arbitrary convention of this figure

candidates.q: In the uplink MU-MIMO system drawing (lower figure), which symbol labels the vertical double-headed dimension arrow at the left edge of the BS array?
candidates.why_arbitrary: which of the two array dimensions was named w and which ℓ is an arbitrary labelling choice shown only in the drawing

candidates.q: In the bar chart beneath the micrographs, approximately how many migration cells/field are plotted for the 50 µmol/l bar?
candidates.why_arbitrary: it is a measured plotted bar height, readable only from the chart

candidates.q: What is the topmost numeric tick label on the y-axis of the bar chart beneath the micrographs?
candidates.why_arbitrary: the axis ceiling chosen for the plot is an arbitrary tick extreme

candidates.q: In the left-hand gel image, what fragment size is annotated at the right of the gel for the C allele band?
candidates.why_arbitrary: the assay's fragment sizes are printed annotations specific to this genotyping design

candidates.q: In the left-hand gel image, which genotype is written above the third sample lane (counting the lanes to the right of the marker lane M)?
